sections.Profile:
Surf Side , designed by Ed Krynski and featuring artwork by Art Stenholm, was released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1967. This two-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine was produced in a limited run of 1,750 units. The gameplay incorporates four flippers, three pop bumpers, and two roto-targets, with players advancing multiplier ladders and collecting bonuses by hitting specific standup targets.
